services.name: Improv Classes
services.desc: Our adult improv classes are for everyone! Start with our Improv 101 class*, and if you catch the improv bug, keep taking more! Click the buttons below for detailed date and location information and enrollment for each course. Not sure if you’re ready to dive in yet? Try out Improv Taste Test, our drop-in class held Mondays at our theater on 20th Street! All listed prerequisites for advanced-level classes must be completed prior to registration, regardless of previous training. Every comedy school approaches their curriculum and philosophy differently. It is important, and beneficial, for you and your classmates to have the same level of Comedy Spot training and vocabulary. blurb: Our improv classes are perfect fit for everyone! Basically, you are going to laugh for two hours each week and play like a kid! You will learn how to create comedy scenes off the top of your head, with no preparation or planning, Meet people, have fun, and laugh!
